rationale: The bid-ask spread of 250 bps is prohibitively wide, creating an immediate structural disadvantage that would require a significant move just to break even. Price is sitting at 10% of today's range (near the low) after a sharp intraday reversal from $237.12 down to $222.40, with the last print well below VWAP ($229.29) and the 9-EMA ($225.46), suggesting distribution after the earnings gap-up. The combination of extreme spread cost, unclear directional momentum after the reversal, and already-committed capital in two working orders makes this an unfavorable risk/reward setup in either direction.
